caption: The drawing depicts a single, large metal bell with a yoke at the top for hanging. The bell is colored in shades of brown and dark gray, giving it a weathered, metallic appearance. The yoke, which is the armature supporting the bell, is curved and has the words "NO. 30 YOKE" inscribed on it. The bell's clapper is faintly indicated at its base. The background is plain and unembellished, with a light cream or off-white color. The artist’s signature, "W.M. Techhoffel," is written in the lower right corner of the drawing. The composition is centered on the bell, with no other objects present.
title: Bell
